decisions.question: How does `record` pair a deviation (`--also`, `--substitute`) with its `--cite`?

options.summary: each --cite binds every uncited --also/--substitute given before it
one --cite for the whole record
PATH=ID inside the flag value

decisions.rationale: Keeps the spec's `--also PATH --cite ID` syntax and lets one record cite two entries; a deviation with no --cite after it is refused, naming the path or node.

decisions.question: Which status does the status view take from a receipt whose seal is broken?

options.summary: the receipt's status; check, verify and the gates still refuse the seal
PENDING, as if the receipt were absent

decisions.rationale: verify and the dependency gate then name the broken record and its repair instead of silently treating the item as open, the behavior a sealed plan has today.

decisions.question: How do the sealed and legacy schemes stay proven once a first freeze stores receipts?

options.summary: existing driver suites run with plan_record.FIRST_SCHEME patched to sealed
a new tests/scripts/test_plan_receipts_legacy.py (the spec's name)

decisions.rationale: The spec's legacy file would pass before the work, so it cannot be planned red; the existing suites (test_plan_driver.py, test_plan_record_driver.py, test_plan_api.py) already pin every sealed and legacy behavior and stay green, assertions unchanged, under an autouse fixture.

decisions.question: Does the todo-watch mod change?

options.summary: no change
watch receipts and DesignEvolution

decisions.rationale: isWatchedPath already matches every path under the plans folder (plugins/todo-watch/hooks/checks.ts:188-198), and no P rule reads receipts or the DesignEvolution, so a write of either has nothing to recheck. Spec deviation.

decisions.question: Does todo_sync rule P2 change?

options.summary: no change
P2 accepts a sealed COMPLETE receipt

decisions.rationale: A receipts plan's JSON statuses stay PENDING for good, so P2 never meets a COMPLETE item there; a hand-set COMPLETE is a digest problem for check. Spec deviation.

decisions.question: Which PIP does a plan that was never frozen render?

options.summary: the HTML page; markdown only for plans frozen sealed or legacy
HTML only when its first freeze stores receipts (scheme_for); a first receipts freeze moves a `_PIP.md` documentation to the page
decided at `new`: a plan whose documentation names `_PIP.md` stays sealed
markdown until the first freeze

decisions.rationale: Developer's choice after review. Nine never-frozen plans (0001-0008) carry COMPLETE items and can never be first-frozen, so they keep markdown; plan 1012 (unfrozen, all PENDING, documentation `_PIP.md`) gets the page at its first freeze, which repoints documentation before the digest and deletes the superseded `_PIP.md`. Keying the format on `plan_record.scheme_for` keeps the D3 fixture's legacy suites on markdown end to end.

decisions.question: Where do the DesignEvolution enums live?

options.summary: a new standard-library module, like plan_enums
beside the plan enums

decisions.rationale: Keeps plan_enums to plan vocabularies; StrEnum members with snake-case names (IssueCategory.spec_coverage), values unchanged from the old schema.

decisions.question: Does a receipt bind the text of each DesignChange it cites?

options.summary: Deviations.change_digests holds the sha256 of each cited change; the seal covers it and check compares it with the catalog
existence and names-the-item checks only

decisions.rationale: Developer's choice after review: editing a cited change after its receipt asks for a new record, so the trail from receipt to change cannot drift silently.

decisions.question: How is `live.js` kept out of git?

options.summary: write_live keeps `<plans>/<id>/.gitignore` listing live.js
the README tells each project to add an ignore line

decisions.rationale: Project rule: a setting a driver can act on belongs in the driver, not in prose a project must follow. One tracked line beside the receipts; no root `.gitignore` entry. Spec deviation.

decisions.question: How do plan.py commands read the record rules of two schemes?

options.summary: plan_receipts.book_for(plans_dir, plan) returns one RecordBook (holds, status, nodes, problems, view) per command
the status view plus a scheme branch at each record-rule call site

decisions.rationale: One branch point in plan.py instead of six; a missed call site cannot report a receipts item as 'COMPLETE without a sealed record'. The view stays for plan_lanes and plan_red, which take a plan.
